data.description:
## Context
Contract removal is complete only when the entire planner/coordinator/adapter path passes portable end-to-end scenarios and the architecture, operator behavior, future adapter obligations, and rollback are durable.

## Outcome
Run credential-free verified-fake Cloud/DC passes over the complete taxonomy, finalize ADR 0100 and architecture/operator docs, and prove no removed production path is reachable.

## Plan
1. Build end-to-end fake Cloud/DC passes covering mixed success, transient recovery, long-delay deferral, permanent ticket failure, auth/provider stop, fuse open/reset, label-first create, restart, partial outcome, and delivery failure.
2. Run the route census and runtime poison checks with the end-to-end suite. Keep bounded live probes optional operator evidence rather than a portable gate.
3. Finalize ADR 0100 with retry ownership, failure taxonomy, fuse, containment, intentional deltas, expand/contract cutover, and rollback.
4. Document planner -> coordinator -> adapter dependency direction, versioned output, operations guidance, and future adapter atomic-operation/retry obligations.
5. Verify rollback re-observes remote state and never deletes successful Jira work.

## Testing
The interface suite uses no external credentials and runs in every supported local/CI environment. ADR/doc index and route-census tests are mandatory.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Portable fake Cloud/DC suites cover every named outcome, fuse, create, restart, partial, and delivery scenario.
- [ ] End-to-end tests require no external credential or CI-provider-specific trigger.
- [ ] Route census and poison tests find no reachable removed fallback.
- [ ] ADR 0100 records ownership, taxonomy, fuse, containment, intentional deltas, cutover, and no-delete rollback.
- [ ] Architecture/operator docs define versioned outcomes and future adapter obligations.
- [ ] ADR numbering, documentation index, and architecture links pass.

## Out of scope
Optional live probes do not gate completion.
data.title: RP-03 S5 T3 — Validate the complete coordinator and finalize ADR 0100
